summary: Maxeon Solar Technologies, Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting that it and its subsidiary voluntarily applied for judicial management in Singapore under the Insolvency, Restructuring and Dissolution Act 2018. Interim judicial management was granted on April 9, 2026, with a hearing scheduled for May 29, 2026. Three independent directors (Colvin, Leonard, and Teo Tong Kooi) resigned in early May 2026; the interim judicial managers are considering replacements. This filing updates the restructuring process, akin to a US Chapter 11 bankruptcy proceeding. Watch for the court's decision on formal judicial management, potential restructuring plan, creditor negotiations, and any impact on equity, which may be severely impaired.
